text:
nora: hey team, opening my first PR and want to follow the "team norms". quick list: branch prefix, commit one-liner style, PR size guidance, and who to ping for a quick sanity check?
ethan: welcome nora! Branch pattern we use is `feature/ENG-<ticket>-short-desc` or `hotfix/ENG-<ticket>-brief`. keep the slug under ~50 chars and use kebab-case.
viv: PR size: prefer focused changes (<250 LOC). if you have mechanical churn (formatting, renames) separate that from behavioral logic changes. two PRs beats a big one.
nora: for commit messages do we need strict conventional commits?
ethan: we prefer lightweight conventional-ish. examples: `feat(cache): add prefix eviction (ENG-7331)` or `fix(api): handle 400 on malformed header`. put ticket id in subject or first line of body.
viv: include a short "How to test locally" section in the PR body. Also run `./scripts/preflight.sh` before pushing (lint, unit tests, type checks).
ci-bot: [ci-bot] Build queued for branch feature/ENG-7331-nora-ttl : lint pending, unit-tests pending
nora: CI sometimes flakes for me on integration jobs that hit external services. what should I do if that happens?
ethan: open the PR normally and note flaky jobs in the description. tag `@eng-oncall` or `@devops` for reruns. if it's reproducible, file a flake ticket and assign to `@eng-infra`.
viv: check CODEOWNERS for auto-requested reviewers. Approval rule: 1 CODEOWNER OR 2 reviewers. Security-impacting changes need `@sec-eng` signoff.
nora: merge strategy? squash or keep commits?
ethan: squash for small fixes, keep logical commits for a feature where intermediate steps are meaningful. when in doubt, ask in the PR whether reviewer prefers squashed history.
nora: any labels we should add?
viv: add `area/*` and `type/*`, estimate `size/xs|s|m|l`. add `backport-needed` if it affects maintained releases and `breaking-change` for API/schema changes.
devex-mentor: tip: paste this minimal checklist into your PR body:
```
- Summary of change
- Ticket: ENG-7331
- How to run locally (commands/env)
- CI status / flakiness notes
- Labels: area/*, type/*, size/*
- Generated files included? yes/no
```
nora: awesome, thanks! i'll open a Draft PR, run preflight, attach the checklist, and ping `@ethan` for a quick pass before requesting formal reviews. much appreciated :sparkles:
